financeReceivablesChangeInOCF.note: Originations of loans originally classified as held for sale (−14,191,399) and repayments (+14,248,689), net +57,290, sit in operating cash flow. From 2025, loans originally classified as held for investment (originations −17,629,689, repayments +14,080,787), mainly Cash App Borrow, and consumer receivables are in investing, so they do not affect OCF. Settlement and customer-payable swings (−487,316 and +373,925) are also inside operating cash flow.

paidOutFormula: revenue 24,193,683 − operating cash flow 2,579,714 + capex 155,038 (USD thousands, as stated)
notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (FY2025 Form 10-K, accession 0001628280-26-012254). Payments company: formula with the sector flag. Revenue includes bitcoin ecosystem revenue of 8,502,787 thousand recorded gross, so the cost of the bitcoin sold counts in paidOut. Interest and income taxes paid are inside operating cash flow; income taxes paid are from the income-tax note's table by jurisdiction (net of refunds). The held-for-sale loan flows inside OCF were a small net inflow in 2025, so the financeReceivablesInOCF bias is minor this year.
